purpose: Exploratory correlated-entrypoint follow-up after an explicitly labelled metadata pilot
capability_grouping: Both view_standardize nodes use the same implementation and StandardScaler dependency and therefore share one retired preprocessing entrypoint
hypothesis: A correlated shared-entrypoint loss exposes complementarity between view retention choices while an explicitly stored concat can eliminate the local-search gap
pilot_disclosure: After the separate-group grid began, one wine seed 20261016 v64 manifest was tested with shared grouping. Fused exact retained 138676 bytes and local 270469 bytes; concat both retained 130480 bytes. Pilot wall timings were concurrent and are not final benchmark timings. This motivated the full fixed grid and all 36 configurations are retained
accounting: Same captured bytes and metadata and new shared fault contract for all methods; robust heuristics compared at full candidate budget and published materializers at exact minimum budget
manual_control: Choose smallest feasible of roots plus both view outputs or roots plus all model and probability targets or roots plus shared concat when present
limitations: Exploratory diagnostic after a favourable disclosed pilot rather than independent confirmation
Adapted two-view histories and declared entrypoint restrictions rather than observed production outages
Original separate-group grid preserved in full
All fused and concat controls and small and large histories retained
No claim of universal dominance or new min-cut theory
Manual frontier is a retention-set control rather than a new native DVC execution
